# Giverny Impression

> > A photographic and educational resource dedicated to Claude Monet's gardens, home, and artistic legacy in Giverny, France.

Giverny Impression showcases the beauty of Monet's gardens through seasonal photography by Ariane, while providing comprehensive information about the Impressionist master's life, family, paintings, and the historic village of Giverny in the Seine Valley. The site serves as both a visual celebration and practical guide for visitors interested in Monet's world.

## Key Topics

- Claude Monet
- Giverny
- Monet's Gardens
- Impressionism
- Water Garden
- Flower Garden Photography
- Grandes Decorations
- Monet's Family (Camille, Alice, Jean, Michel)
- Vernon
- Seine Valley
- Garden Photography
- Water Lilies
- Japanese Bridge
- Seasonal Gardens
- French Countryside

## Monet's Life & Art

- [Monet's Paintings](http://giverny-impression.com/photo-gallery/monet-painting): Gallery of Monet's paintings and Impressionist art reproductions
- [Monet's Family](http://giverny-impression.com/monets-family): Biography of Claude Monet's family: Camille, Jean, Michel & Alice
- [Grandes Decorations](http://giverny-impression.com/grandes-decorations): Monet's water lily murals at Orangerie Museum in Paris
- [Series Painting: A Small World](http://giverny-impression.com/series-painting-a-small-world): Monet's series painting technique in water garden Impressionist works

## Giverny Village & Monet's Home

- [The Village of Giverny](http://giverny-impression.com/the-village-of-giverny): Overview of Giverny village, Claude Monet's home in Seine Valley
- [Monet's Dining Room](http://giverny-impression.com/monets-dining-room): Monet's yellow dining room with Japanese prints at Giverny house
- [Monet Small Bridge](http://giverny-impression.com/monet-small-bridge): Small wisteria bridge in Monet's water garden at Giverny

## Garden Photography by Season

- [The Colors of June](http://giverny-impression.com/the-colors-of-june): June flowers and rose garden photography at Monet's Giverny garden
- [A Taste of Heaven](http://giverny-impression.com/a-taste-of-heaven): Spring flowers in Monet's paradise garden at Giverny in May-June
- [Late Season](http://giverny-impression.com/late-season): Autumn blooms and waterlilies in Monet's garden at late season
- [Misty Days](http://giverny-impression.com/misty-days): Misty autumn-winter photography of Monet's water garden & pond
- [The Empty Garden](http://giverny-impression.com/the-empty-garden): Monet's garden during winter closure and seasonal maintenance
- [Snow Again](http://giverny-impression.com/snow-again): Winter snow photography in Giverny, Vernon & Old Mill of Vernon

## Visitor Resources

- [B&B](http://giverny-impression.com/bed_breakfast): Bed & breakfast accommodation directory for Giverny lodging
- [Giverny Calendar](http://giverny-impression.com/giverny-calendar): Giverny calendar featuring Monet's garden photography by Ariane
- [30 Monets at Giverny next year!](http://giverny-impression.com/30-monets-at-giverny-next-year): Announcement of 2009 Monet exhibition at Giverny museum with 30 works

## Optional

- [Wild Rose](http://giverny-impression.com/wild-rose-o): Wild rose photography in Giverny countryside during springtime
- [Squirrel](http://giverny-impression.com/squirrel): Red squirrel wildlife photography and behavior in French countryside
- [Tamed Horses](http://giverny-impression.com/tamed-horses): Frederick MacMonnies horse sculpture at A.G. Poulain Museum, Vernon
- [Needle Works](http://giverny-impression.com/needle-works): Alice Monet's 19th-century needlework hobbies at Clos Normand
